Context: 14. Change of Accommodation

## 14. Change of Accommodation  
- An allottee may apply for a change to another same Type of accommodation only after taking physical possession of accommodation
- (1) allotted under initial allotment.
- (2) Only one change shall be allowed in the same Type of accommodation
- to the allottee.
- (3) An allottee, shall make an application in the form specified by the Directorate of Estates, and thereafter, the name of such allottee shall be
- included in the concerned Type unified waiting list.
